description: This file contains utility functions for calculating selection ranges in table columns and rows within a ProseMirror editor, specifically handling merged cells and their spanning attributes.

methods.name: getSelectionRangeInColumn
methods.description: Calculates a rectangular selection range around a specified column index, considering merged cells with colspan attributes.

methods.name: getSelectionRangeInRow
methods.description: Calculates a rectangular selection range around a specified row index, considering merged cells with rowspan attributes.
